description: Customer lifetime value (monthly revenue per account x gross margin / monthly churn) compared with customer acquisition cost. Returns LTV, the LTV:CAC ratio and CAC payback months. Around 3:1 or better is a commonly cited target. Use cac_payback when you only need the payback period. Guide: https://raziel.co/learn/unit-economics-early-stage-startups

arpa_monthly_usd.description: Average revenue per account per month.

cac_usd.description: Fully loaded cost to acquire one customer (sales and marketing spend / new customers).

monthly_churn_pct.description: Monthly customer churn in percent (2 = 2%). Must be above 0.

name: ltv_cac
title: LTV to CAC
